bookings_cancelled_ck.name: bookings_cancelled_ck
bookings_cancelled_ck.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('cancelled', 'late_cancelled') or ("bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null and "bookings"."cancel_reason_code" is not null)

session_exceptions_special_hours_ck.name: session_exceptions_special_hours_ck
session_exceptions_special_hours_ck.value: ("session_exceptions"."kind" = 'special_hours') = ("session_exceptions"."opens_at" is not null and "session_exceptions"."closes_at" is not null)

session_exceptions_hours_order_ck.name: session_exceptions_hours_order_ck
session_exceptions_hours_order_ck.value: "session_exceptions"."closes_at" is null or "session_exceptions"."opens_at" is null or "session_exceptions"."closes_at" > "session_exceptions"."opens_at"

sessions_lead_window_ck.name: sessions_lead_window_ck
sessions_lead_window_ck.value: "sessions"."lead_window_end_at" is null or "sessions"."lead_window_start_at" is null or "sessions"."lead_window_end_at" > "sessions"."lead_window_start_at"

sessions_lead_magnet_ck.name: sessions_lead_magnet_ck
sessions_lead_magnet_ck.value: "sessions"."is_lead_magnet" = false or ("sessions"."kind" = 'event' and "sessions"."lead_window_start_at" is not null and "sessions"."lead_window_end_at" is not null)

ticket_types_sales_window_ck.name: ticket_types_sales_window_ck
ticket_types_sales_window_ck.value: "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_start_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" > "ticket_types"."sales_start_at"

checkouts_contact_chk.name: checkouts_contact_chk
checkouts_contact_chk.value: "checkouts"."person_id" is not null or "checkouts"."email" is not null or "checkouts"."status" = 'started'

order_lines_session_chk.name: order_lines_session_chk
order_lines_session_chk.value: "order_lines"."product_kind" not in ('session', 'night', 'ticket') or ("order_lines"."session_id" is not null and "order_lines"."quantity" = 1 and ("order_lines"."data"->'booking_ids' is null or (jsonb_typeof("order_lines"."data"->'booking_ids') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("order_lines"."data"->'booking_ids') = 1)))

pos_day_closes_note_chk.name: pos_day_closes_note_chk
pos_day_closes_note_chk.value: "pos_day_closes"."difference_cents" is null or "pos_day_closes"."difference_cents" = 0 or "pos_day_closes"."note" is not null

pos_day_closes_closed_chk.name: pos_day_closes_closed_chk
pos_day_closes_closed_chk.value: "pos_day_closes"."status" <> 'closed' or ("pos_day_closes"."counted_cash_cents" is not null and "pos_day_closes"."closed_at" is not null)

products_package_chk.name: products_package_chk
products_package_chk.value: "products"."kind" <> 'package' or ("products"."credit_kind" in ('day', 'night') and "products"."credit_units" is not null and "products"."validity_days" is not null)

products_membership_chk.name: products_membership_chk
products_membership_chk.value: ("products"."kind" = 'membership') = ("products"."recurring_interval" is not null) and ("products"."included_credit_kind" is null) = ("products"."included_credit_units" is null)

credit_entries_sign_ck.name: credit_entries_sign_ck
credit_entries_sign_ck.value: ("credit_entries"."kind" not in ('grant', 'transfer_in', 'release') or "credit_entries"."quantity" > 0) and ("credit_entries"."kind" not in ('consume', 'expire', 'revoke', 'transfer_out') or "credit_entries"."quantity" < 0)

credit_entries_adjust_ck.name: credit_entries_adjust_ck
credit_entries_adjust_ck.value: "credit_entries"."kind" <> 'adjust' or ("credit_entries"."quantity" <> 0 and "credit_entries"."reason" is not null and length(btrim("credit_entries"."reason")) >= 3)

credit_grants_order_line_ck.name: credit_grants_order_line_ck
credit_grants_order_line_ck.value: "credit_grants"."source" not in ('purchase', 'voucher') or "credit_grants"."order_line_id" is not null

activity_events_subject_ck.name: activity_events_subject_ck
activity_events_subject_ck.value: "activity_events"."person_id" is not null or "activity_events"."company_id" is not null

persons_name_length_ck.name: persons_name_length_ck
persons_name_length_ck.value: ("persons"."first_name" is null or char_length("persons"."first_name") <= 100) and ("persons"."last_name" is null or char_length("persons"."last_name") <= 100)

persons_status_override_reason_ck.name: persons_status_override_reason_ck
persons_status_override_reason_ck.value: "persons"."status_override" is null or "persons"."status_override_reason" is not null

form_versions_publisher_ck.name: form_versions_publisher_ck
form_versions_publisher_ck.value: "form_versions"."published_by_user_id" is null or "form_versions"."published_at" is not null

files_name_ck.name: files_name_ck
files_name_ck.value: char_length("files"."name") between 1 and 200 and strpos("files"."name", '/') = 0 and strpos("files"."name", chr(92)) = 0

support_requests_resolved_ck.name: support_requests_resolved_ck
support_requests_resolved_ck.value: "support_requests"."status" not in ('resolved', 'closed') or "support_requests"."resolved_at" is not null

users_audience_shape_ck.name: users_audience_shape_ck
users_audience_shape_ck.value: ("users"."audience" = 'staff' and "users"."role_key" is not null) or ("users"."audience" = 'customer' and "users"."role_key" is null and "users"."person_id" is not null)

redirects_target_ck.name: redirects_target_ck
redirects_target_ck.value: ("redirects"."to_page_id" is not null and "redirects"."to_locale" is not null and "redirects"."to_url" is null) or ("redirects"."to_page_id" is null and "redirects"."to_locale" is null and "redirects"."to_url" is not null)

redirects_to_url_ck.name: redirects_to_url_ck
redirects_to_url_ck.value: "redirects"."to_url" is null or (("redirects"."to_url" like '/%' or "redirects"."to_url" like 'https://%') and length("redirects"."to_url") <= 500 and "redirects"."to_url" <> "redirects"."from_path")
